Name: Four corners visual fix
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
There are 2 bushes and a tree root in the middle of the Four corners farm that glitches in front of tall buildings (obelisks, silos).

This mod moves them from the 'AlwaysFront' map layer to the 'Front' map layer, which fixes that.

I used the 'EditMap' CP function so it only edits twelve tiles (37,23 -42,24). It [b]does not replace the whole map[/b], so should be compatible with other mods that make small edits to the map.
